description: Figure 7 is a vertical bar chart illustrating the number of questions (out of 40) for which chain-of-thought (CoT) generated by GPT3 contains at least one factual error, shown for multiple datasets and methods. The horizontal axis contains four category labels—HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC—arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is a numeric count scale (linear) ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. Each dataset category displays a grouped set of three bars identified by the legend: NoR QA (orange), OneR QA (red), and IRCoT QA (blue with diagonal hatching), with values printed above each bar. For HotpotQA, the bars are approximately 15 (NoR QA), 10 (OneR QA), and 5 (IRCoT QA). For 2WikiMQA, the bars are approximately 29 (NoR QA), 23 (OneR QA), and 14 (IRCoT QA). For MuSiQue, the bars are approximately 28 (NoR QA), 27 (OneR QA), and 23 (IRCoT QA). For IIRC, the bars are approximately 15 (NoR QA), 14 (OneR QA), and 11 (IRCoT QA). The bars are not shown as sorted by magnitude; they are grouped by dataset, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct colors/pattern used to differentiate methods.
